values: Remove the unsupported equations equating glancing values to calculated values and deriving total force, Pavg, b, and w from maxima; I2-014 supplies no such formula. Obtain canonical calculation/provenance relationship or formula-model terms to validate that each case's F, Q, P, and AR is calculated at its midpoint and that the respective maxima are used to calculate Pavg, b, and w, rather than imposing invented arithmetic.

No supplied candidate is semantically verified: calculationCase is a generic calculation-case class and ship is an owner class, while the feedback requires a canonical bow-form classification/selection term or path for I2.3.1(v).

Candidate faithfully targets the ship and the supplied calculation/table-case owners, enforces all declared operands and results with the correct quantity datatypes and units, and implements the conditional DF, force conversion to kN, and line-load formulas with expected-result-scaled tolerances.

Add and enforce the supplied required structural-member relationship nltl:spansHullArea in the applicable boundary-spanning model. The COMPLETE dependency contract declares spansHullArea as a relationship term, but the candidate omits it entirely and therefore does not require the declared spanning evidence.

No supplied candidate is semantically verified for the required hull-area classification path and controlled values BI_b, M_b, and S_b; hullArea is only an unapproved string property, while plating and framingAngleOmega do not provide the required hull-area applicability semantics.

Add canonical relationship path(s) linking the applicable structural member, plating/Omega, and calculation case; do not evaluate disjoint ship children by combinatorial joins. On that linked case, require and validate plasticNeutralAxisHeight against the stated z_na formula (with derived-result tolerance), require the relevant reported sectionModulus/result, and connect it to the Z_p calculation. Implement the strict 20<Omega<70 conditional linear-interpolation equation using the mandatory 20 and 70 endpoint results, and require the direct/formula versus interpolation branch evidence so missing branch-selection data cannot pass. The current optional/disconnected sectionModulus, plasticNeutralAxisHeight, framingAngleOmega, calculation case, and endpoints neither enforce nor evaluate the required interpolation/result semantics.

Constrain every selected local-frame node to nltl:structuralMember (and retain nltl:localFrame) before applying nltl:structuralLocation, nltl:midspanPlasticCollapseLoad, and nltl:hasStructuralMemberLoadCase, whose declared owner is structuralMember; do not apply these properties to an untyped localFrame. Remove sh:minCount 1 on hasStructuralMemberLoadCase: the requirement's every-load-case demand/orientation rules do not independently require that a load case exist. Keep the bounded comparison and bottom-case orientation violations conditional on actual linked load cases.
Candidate faithfully encodes the I2.6.2 formula, unit conversions, owner paths, calculated-result tolerance, and A_w >= A_t comparison.

Replace the convenience nltl:sideStructureApplicability boolean gate and its mandatory-presence check with the canonical structural-member relationship/path and controlled value that establishes side-structure membership (including nltl:sideStructureLocation). That required relationship/path is not supplied in the scoped vocabulary, so locate it before repair; then apply the load-case demand and plastic-strength comparison only to those selected side-structure longitudinal local frames.

Candidate faithfully encodes the ship-targeted universal structural-member constraint, controlled section alternatives, required quantity owners, decimal datatypes, MPa/mm units, and inclusive formula boundary.

Remove the SPARQL rule requiring every Polar Class ship to identify at least one member: this is an unsupported existence requirement for a universal every-item rule. Replace the plating-only check with coverage of every internal ice-strengthened structure within the applicable hull area, including plated members adjacent to shell and stiffener webs/flanges; do not require the range object to be nltl:internalStructure when the canonical relationship range is nltl:internalIceStrengthenedStructure. Preserve corrosionAbrasionAllowance only on its authoritative plating owner, and obtain the canonical property/path needed to validate the required addition for non-plating stiffener webs and flanges. Also account for the COMPLETE dependency-contract operands asBuiltThickness and corrosionAbrasionAddition where required by the comparison model; the current graph omits them and cannot represent the full requirement.

Faithfully encodes the ship-to-calculation-case model, linked endpoint membership, operand ownership, unit compatibility, strict intermediate interval, and linear-interpolation result using an expected-result-scaled tolerance.

Repair the calculation-case ownership and formula comparison: do not impose the invented requirement that every hull-girder case must also be linked by hasCalculationCase merely to associate evidence. Model hasCalculationCase and its calculationCase-owned interpolation evidence on the declared calculationCase owner, and ensure any hull-girder case receiving hasInterpolationPoint is explicitly a calculationCase as required by that property's owner/domain. Replace the fifth-power ratio test with a bounded derived-result comparison whose tolerance is scaled from the expected M_I formula result (with the absolute fallback), not from a transformed power ratio; retain math:sin and the sin(gamma_stem)^(-0.2) operand semantics.

When the local-frame area exceeds the attached-plate-flange area, z_na = (100*A_fn + h_w*t_wn - 1000*t_pn*s)/(2*t_wn) [mm]. The net effective plastic section modulus is Z_p = t_pn*s*(z_na + t_pn/2)*sin(phi_w) + (((h_w - z_na)^2 + z_na^2)*t_wn*sin(phi_w))/2000 + A_fn*((h_fc - z_na)*sin(phi_w) - b_w*cos(phi_w))/10 [cm^3]. For oblique framing (70 deg > Omega > 20 deg), use linear interpolation.
When A_fn exceeds the attached-plate-flange area, calculate z_na and Z_p using the equations in I2.5.8-I2.5.9. For 20<Omega<70 degrees use linear interpolation between linked endpoint results.

For each longitudinal local frame whose structuralLocation is sideStructureLocation, every represented load-case combined shear-and-bending demand must not exceed the member plastic strength/midspan plastic-collapse load.
